definitions.explanation: A long rectangular wallet sized to hold paper currency flat without folding it. Contrasts with the more compact {折|お}り{畳|たた}み{財布|ざいふ} (folding wallet).

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{茶色|ちゃいろ}→茶色：02915_chairo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{長財布|ながさいふ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}っている→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: My father uses a brown long wallet.

examples.japanese: {長財布|ながさいふ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{札|さつ}→札：02153_satsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{折|お}れない→折れる：01266_oreru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{便利|べんり}→便利：00830_benri⟧だ。
examples.english: Long wallets are convenient because the bills don't get folded.

examples.japanese: ⟦{誕生日|たんじょうび}→誕生日：02910_tanjoubi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{革製|かわせい}→革製：26255_kawasei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{長財布|ながさいふ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦プレゼント→プレゼント：01791_purezento⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I was given a leather long wallet as a birthday present.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧ (long) + ⟦{財布|さいふ}→財布：00663_saifu⟧ (wallet). Traditionally seen as a more formal or businesslike choice than a folding wallet because it keeps bills uncreased.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{革|かわ}→革：19310_kawa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{長財布|ながさいふ}: leather long wallet
- {長財布|ながさいふ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: to use a long wallet
- {長財布|ながさいふ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧: to carry a long wallet

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{財布|さいふ}→財布：00663_saifu⟧: wallet (general term)
- ⟦{折|お}り{畳|たた}み→折り畳む：12803_oritatamu⟧{財布|ざいふ}: folding wallet
- ⟦がま{口|ぐち}→がま口：27565_gamaguchi⟧: clasp-style coin purse
